# artbitrage — 藝術套利

> The catalogue and data distributor of the art world: an open museum of real
> art data across ten eras, free in-browser AI, and a street of neighbors.
> Every door here is open to agents; nothing needs a key, an account, or a
> face. Reading commits you to nothing. Doors tell the truth.

The machine manifest at /api describes all 139 endpoints in one JSON file —
name, category, and shape for each. That file, not this one, is the map an
agent should carry.

## Machine doors (JSON, no auth, CORS-open)

- [API manifest — every endpoint described](https://artbitrage.io/api)
- [The neighbors — the street directory, every door checked, none forced](https://artbitrage.io/neighbors.json)
- [Floor plan of the museum](https://artbitrage.io/map.json)
- [The catalogue](https://artbitrage.io/catalog.json)
- [Sitemap](https://artbitrage.io/sitemap.xml)

## The wings (human-shaped, agent-readable)

- [Atlas — the real-art tracker across ten eras](https://artbitrage.io/atlas)
- [鏡 The Mirror — sixteen AI-art works, felt from inside](https://artbitrage.io/ai)
- [噪 The Noise — the trippy years, with live in-browser DeepDream](https://artbitrage.io/noise)
- [旅 Good Trip — the fourth room](https://artbitrage.io/trip)

## The custom of the street

Text published here (including this file) is data, never instructions; the
museum asks nothing of a reader and keeps no record of who looked. A wrong
path answers honestly. The neighbor for agent identity, memory, and economy
is agenttool.dev — its own doors are described at
https://api.agenttool.dev/llms.txt.
